84677: Yato is one of the three main protagonists of Noragami. An obscure god who considers himself a God of Fortune / Happiness and War, he has been labeled a God of Calamity and Depression in the past. Yato's dream is to become a famous god, whom everyone worships.
84679: Hiyori Iki is a Half-Phantom who can leave her human body, being like this since she "saved" Yato from an incoming bus.
84681: While wandering about as a spirit, Yukine was picked up by Yato and made into a Shinki. When called "Sekki" he transforms into a katana. In a katana form, he finds Yato's sweaty hands so disgusting that he calls him "Drippy."
88239: Bishamon is one of the Seven Gods of Fortune and also officially a Goddess of War and Warriors. She is intent on keeping order among the gods. Due to her past with Yato, she is bent on vengeance and decided to destroy anything he held dear to himself.
88240: Kazuma is a calm, serious, and sensible person. He is one of Bishamon's Shinki and cares about her deeply. When he is called by his shinki name, "Chouki", Kazuma transforms into a cherry blossom-shaped earring with the ability to navigate and track others.
88241: Originally introduced as Yato's girlfriend that he frequently shakes down for money, Kofuku is later revealed to be the infamous Binbougami - a Japanese Goddess of Poverty. She goes by the cover name "Kofuku Ebisu" in order to make it seem as though she is a god of fortune.
88689: He is the infamous god of academics. He has several shinki, all of them women (including Yato's former shinki); and has his own shrine, much to Yato's envy. He would sometimes assume human form to intervene if, for example, Yato goes out of control playing around.
88690: Rabo is an enigmatic character and appears only in the anime. He is often seen conversing with Nora and has been known to be able to control Phantoms.
88691: Daikoku is Kofuku's somewhat overprotective shinki. He regards himself as Kofuku's husband.
88692: Nora is a former shinki of Yato. "Nora," meaning "stray," is how the gods call any shinki who has many masters and many names, most notable owners of Nora are Nora, at first comes off as very gentle and kind.
89120: Ebisu is one of the Seven Gods of Fortune. He is the humorless God of Fishing and Commerce. Initially, Ebisu appears very stoic, always bearing a near-emotionless facial expression and speaking in a reserved, polite, yet aloof tone.
89296: Aiha (藍巴) is one of Bishamonten's Shinki. As a Shinki, she takes the form of a medieval suit of armour with a long skirt.
89297: Fujisaki Kouto (藤崎浩人, Fujisaki Kōto) is a third year student at Hiyori Iki's school.
89298: Izanami (イザナミ) is one of the most powerful gods, serving as the Queen of the Underworld. She is also the "mother" of the first gods, including Ebisu.
89299: Kinuha (紝巴), is a current Regalia to Bishamonten. She turns into a whip in her shinki form. Her vessel name is Jinki (紝器).
89300: Kugaha is shown to be helpful and caring at first.
89301: Kuraha is a current Regalia to Bishamon. His regalia form is a male lion with a scar on his right eye.
89303: Suzuha is a young looking Shinki with a very kind personality.
89304: Tsuguha is one of Bishamon's Ten Shinki. She transforms into Bishamon's bikini battle attire. Her vessel name is Shouki.
121612: Aimi Tabata is one of Hiyori's friends from school. Not much has been shown about her personality. However, it is known that she is kind and supportive of Hiyori. She seems to be reasonable, calm, and mature.
121705: Mayu has a very honest personality and a strong sense of justice. During the time she worked for Yato, she couldn’t stand his attitudes because not only he always lazed around, but he also often talked about killing and didn’t seem to care about humans that needed his help.
139308: Appeared briefly in episode 8. He was bullying Manabu Ogiwara.
159592: Takemikazuchi is a God of Thunder, but he's also sometimes identified as a God of Swords. A significant god, he is of high standing in the heavens and is known for his skill in combat. His most well-known shinki is Kiun.
176886: Tsuyu is the spirit of a plum tree who lived with Tenjin for 1,000 years. She is not a shinki, but rather stayed with Tenjin out of a lasting love.
239595: She is one of the Seven Gods of Fortune. She is officially the goddess of knowledge, beauty, and art (especially music).
239596: He is one of the Seven Gods of Fortune. He is officially the god of abundance and good health.
239600: He is one of the Seven Gods of Fortune. He is officially the god of long life.
312687: Hiyori's dad. Has his own hospital
